name: software-design-skills
description: Six composable skills that turn a product idea or an existing system into an implementation-ready canonical software design package with bounded independent review, explicit reconciliation, contracts, and vertical build planning.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into an implementation-ready design package
interface.longDescription: A proportional workflow, for new products or a design baseline of an existing system, for shaping product intent, writing a product-authoritative PRD, designing canonical technical artifacts, running mechanical package checks and one bounded independent baseline review, reconciling blocking findings separately, verifying fixes by impact cone, and planning vertical build slices without reopening architecture indefinitely.
defaultPrompt: Shape this product idea before choosing technology.
Write a focused PRD that owns product intent and requirements, not implementation detail.
Design the system and create only the canonical technical artifacts that apply.
Review the design package using a bounded baseline or follow-up verification and record severity-graded findings without editing canonical artifacts.
Reconcile only the current blocking findings, then return them for independent verification.
Write a vertical implementation plan from the approved design package.
